Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU and New Caledonia sign strategic partnership on sustainable raw materials
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the European Commission and the government of New Caledonia signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) establishing a strategic partnership on sustainable raw materials value chains.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: GEMS: An EU-funded project tackling radicalisation in online gaming spaces
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The EU-funded GEMS project examines how vulnerable individuals are identified and recruited in online gaming spaces and has developed an AI-supported moderation tool to detect extremist activity across the diverse world of gaming, interrupting recruitment attempts in real time.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission data shows continued growth in sustainable investments across the EU
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today’s figures highlight the important role the EU’s sustainable finance framework plays in supporting the transition to a more sustainable, resilient, and competitive EU economy

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Access to affordable and adapted housing is prioritised in the Pledge on the Intergenerational Fairness
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Commissioner for Intergenerational Fairness, Youth, Culture and Sport, Glenn Micallef, has launched a pledge on intergenerational fairness. Local and regional elected representatives are invited to sign the Pledge, which has ensuring affordable and adapted housing as one if its 16 commitments.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Joint press release on the 19th implementation meeting of the EU–China Maritime Transport Agreement
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The 19th implementation meeting of the EU–China Maritime Transport Agreement in Shanghai

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission gathers experts to help unlock investment in affordable and sustainable housing
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: More than 100 experts are part of a Joint Working Group, tasked with securing more private and public investments for affordable, energy-efficient and sustainable housing.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU sets out a new Strategy for the Arctic
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the Commission and the High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy presented a new Strategy for the Arctic. The Strategy presents a new framework of political cooperation for like-minded partners that places people, security, climate and prosperity at its core.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: CERIS event on Innovation Uptake
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The CERIS event on innovation uptake gathered more than 120 participants. It provided a space for public authorities, security practitioners, policy makers, innovators and researchers to connect and discuss practical ways to support the transition from research results to deployable solutions.

Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Highlighted in the World Economic Forum’s Global Risks Report 2026, long-term risks to Earth systems, society and the economy are dominated by the impact of climate change, with extreme weather events, biodiversity loss and ecosystem collapse, and critical change to Earth systems ranked among the

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commissioner Kos in Montenegro to attend the Berlin Process Summit and discuss the country’s accession process
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Tomorrow and on Thursday, Commissioner for Enlargement Marta Kos will be in Montenegro to participate at the Berlin Process Summit and to discuss Montenegro’s progress on its accession path.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission data shows continued growth in sustainable investments across the EU
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Over €1.2 trillion has been invested in sustainable activities in the EU since 2021, according to data published by the Commission today.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Click wisely: promoting online safety during European Cybersecurity Month
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Learn about the EU campaign to promote cybersecurity in the Europe and about what the EU is doing to better prepare us for and respond to cybersecurity threats

Commissione, notizie.titolo: An EU strategy for a rapidly changing Arctic
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The new strategy for the Arctic is a framework of cooperation that places people, security, climate and prosperity at its core

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Working through an app or website? See what’s changing for your rights
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Delivering food, driving people from A to B or freelancing online? New EU rules could change your status, unlock employee benefits and stop unfair algorithmic decisions.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: A long-term vision for a successful fisheries and aquaculture sector
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has set out its vision for fisheries and aquaculture towards 2040 to support fishers, aquaculture producers and local communities.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: The Parliament’s EUDS Special Committee visits the Centre
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Parliament’s Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield visits the European Centre for Democratic Resilience

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Solidarity Lanes: Latest figures – September 2026
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Latest figures on Ukrainian exports and imports via the EU-Ukraine Solidarity Lanes: new transport routes established in the face of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU tests put thermal insulating materials under the spotlight
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The results of this EU-funded campaign underline the value of market surveillance and the need for end users to verify performance information before selecting insulation products.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission invests €3.4 billion in net-zero technology projects
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the European Commission has selected 77 European net-zero technology projects to receive funding support worth €3.4 billion under the call of the Innovation Fund, launched in December 2025.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU invests over €390 million in 135 new climate and environment projects
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has today granted more than €390 million to 135 new projects across Europe under the LIFE programme for environment and climate action. The allocated amount represents more than half of the €579 million total investment needs for these projects.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: In focus: Renewable energy – building trust and sharing benefits
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The advantages of renewable energy projects for the local community can be manifold, ranging from economic and social gains to environmental ones.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Jordan-EU Investment Conference opens registration for media
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Ministry of Investment of Jordan and the European Commission announce that registration is open for media outlets wishing to cover the Jordan-EU Investment Conference, scheduled to be held on November 19, 2026 at the King Hussein bin Talal convention Center at the Dead Sea area.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU integrated resolve 2026 exercise: enhancing EU crisis response coordination
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: In line with the preparedness Union strategy, the EU IR26 aims to strengthen the EU’s capacity to respond to a complex crisis of a hybrid nature with crisis scenarios inside and outside of the EU.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU Diplomatic Programme for the Enlargement Region
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Following the successful launch of the European Union Diplomatic Programme for the Enlargement Region (EUDP) in 2025, the College of Europe has published the new call for applications to join the fifth edition of the programme, which is expected to run from 1st February until 2 July 2027.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Greenland and the EU are partners in fisheries and blue economy
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The EU Commissioner for Fisheries and Oceans, Costas Kadis visited Minister for Fisheries, Hunting, Agriculture and Self-sufficiency, Peter Borg in Greenland, on the 15-16 October 2026.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commissioner Roswall and Belgian water ministers commit to strengthening EU water legislation implementation
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: A statement signed by Commissioner Roswall and regional ministers sets out shared priorities to achieve good water status in Belgium.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission sends Statement of Objections to KKR for providing incorrect or misleading information during merger investigation
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has informed KKR & Co. Inc. ('KKR') of its preliminary view that the company provided incorrect and/or misleading information during the 2024 Commission's investigation of KKR's acquisition of NetCo, under the EU Merger Regulation ('EUMR').

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission proposes greater flexibility for use of liquid digestates
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The aim is to facilitate the use of certain liquid digestates as an alternative to chemical fertilisers while ensuring environmental risks are managed.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission statement on the protests in Albania
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: We condemn the use of violence in Tirana and other cities in Albania, including arson, attacks on State institutions and the destruction of public and private property.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: COP17: EU delivering on global targets to protect nature and biodiversity
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The 17th United Nations Biodiversity Conference (CBD COP17) starts in Yerevan next week, as hopes of building a consensus begin.
